title: Polyxd journey
description: A goal with required checkpoints and a done-condition. The same format serves as a flow spec (PM/design), acceptance tests, and agent benchmark tasks.

goal.description: What the user is trying to achieve, in their words

intent.description: Surface intent key(s) that belong to this journey

mode.description: fixed: exact surfaces (regulated flows); guided: checkpoints required, layout generated; open: only goal and done are fixed

rule.description: Must hold on the surface where the checkpoint happens

event.description: Capability event that marks the checkpoint as reached
Capability event that completes the journey

acceptance.description: PM acceptance criteria, checked on every direction, pattern or model change

task.description: Benchmark/agent test: what a simulated user is asked to do and with what data
